messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated TPM for model-family 'zephyr-14b' detected in us-west-2 region. Current 5-min TPM = 3,200 (baseline 800). Auto-mitigation suggested: reduce per-model TPM to 600. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421-7
maria: seeing customer latency spikes and queued requests. ramp started ~09:05 UTC. I'm going to follow the surge runbook.
ben: ack. I'm oncall. can you confirm affected tiers? hosted api only or dedicated as well?
maria: looks like hosted API keys across free+paid. Dedicated customers not affected. Logs show traffic is concentrated to model alias zephyr-14b-cpu and zephyr-14b-gpu.
ben: ok. suggest immediate temporary sculpt: set per-model TPM=600 and RPM=30 for zephyr-14b family. we'll monitor 5m.
maria: agreed. I'll apply change via admin API and post command.
maria: ```bash
# reduce per-model quota for zephyr family
curl -X POST 'https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/quota/update' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_family":"zephyr-14b","tpm":600,"rpm":30,"reason":"live surge mitigation"}'
```
incident-bot: Action recorded: quota change requested by maria. Request queued to control plane.
kevin: FYI applying now from infra side, will cascade within 15s to edge proxies.
samir: added an annotation to the runbook: 'reduced TPM to 600; watch duplicates from client retries'
ben: observing drop in incoming TPM to ~700 after 40s. latency graphs leveling.
maria: customer impact: a subset of long-running streaming sessions reported disconnects. Support pinged with postmortem note. No major errors in model outputs.
ben: leaving this oncall for 30m to bake. maria, can you hand off at 09:50 UTC? I'll take over monitoring and escalate if it rebounds.
maria: handing off to ben. summary: reduction applied, initial relief seen, monitoring in place, support notified. tagging user-facing incidents team. :white_check_mark:
ben: copying action items to ticket INC-2026-0421-7. plan: if TPM stays <900 for 15m keep sculpt, else gradually restore to 800 then full. restore command below when ready.
ben: ```bash
curl -X POST 'https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/quota/update' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_family":"zephyr-14b","tpm":800,"rpm":40,"reason":"post-mitigation restore"}'
```
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-7 updated: mitigation active. paging closed. Monitoring alert threshold adjusted.
kevin: leaving logs and traces pinned to thread. if things look stable at +30m we can close.
samir: noted for follow-up: evaluate batching/quantization suggestions for zephyr in Optimize to reduce peak per-token CPU.
ben: thanks all. handing to next rotation at 10:20 UTC. end.
